antiPatternsToAvoid: Do NOT use homework/textbook titles like 'Day 4 Task 5' - always use curiosity/interview hooks
Do NOT give away the full answer in the video audio - keep solution in caption/pinned comment to maximize comments
Avoid queries with more than 6 lines on screen without zooming - keep code snippets punchy and readable
